reasons.madcap-muscle-red: Its random discard cost fuels Kayo's Might trigger, and hitting a 6+ power card adds +3 power on top of a big red body.
reasons.madcap-charger-red: It discards as a cost and gains go again off a 6+ power discard, which suits a deck full of cards that count as 6+ in hand.
reasons.breakneck-battery-red: Another discard-for-go-again attack that chains Kayo's Might token into continued pressure.
reasons.rumble-grunting-red: After the deck's many discard effects, it is a cheap +4 power go-again pump for the next Brute attack.
reasons.run-roughshod-blue: It pays off the deck's discard-6+ engine, and as a blue it fits the resource curve.
reasons.primeval-bellow-red: It gives +5 to the next Brute attack with go again, and its discard cost also enables Kayo's Might token and Mandible Claw.
reasons.wrecking-ball-red: It draws then discards, which can trigger Kayo's Might, and it intimidates when a 6+ power card is discarded.
reasons.swing-fist-think-later-red: It is a guaranteed go-again attacker whose random discard cost reliably feeds Kayo's hero ability.
reasons.barraging-beatdown-red: It is a stronger version of the Beatdown already in the deck, giving +4 power, intimidate and go again.
reasons.predatory-assault-red: It gains dominate after the deck's frequent 6+ power discards, making big hits hard to block.
